question: **Select the most appropriate option for blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'wake.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the words given in the options:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 wake
 to (cause someone to) become awake and conscious after sleeping or to make someone more active or excited
 
 

 train 
 to prepare someone or yourself for a job, activity, or sport, by learning skills and/or by mental or physical exercise
 
 

 back
 towards a previous place or condition, or an earlier time
 
 

 wave
 a raised line of water that moves across the surface of an area of water, especially the sea
 
 
 
 

 

 
• The context of the sentence is that the swarms of the locust stirred up from a dormant, or inactive state as they made their way through five states in India.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is "wake."
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

​

Complete passage:__ *Swarms of the desert locust, which invaded India via Pakistan in April, have made __(1) their__ way to at least five states, (__2) leaving__ a trail of destruction in their (__3) wake__. Desert locusts move in large groups, (__4) called__ swarms, and can eat crops up (__5) to__ their own weight every day. When millions of __(6) locusts__ descend on a crop, they destroy __(7) everything__. The desert locust is considered the __(8) most__ destructive migratory pest in the world __(9) since__ a single swarm covering one square kilometre can __(10) contain__ up to 80 million locusts. As per eyewitnesses, the swarm which entered India from Pakistan was about two to three kilometres long.*
